Scale: the square plate spans about 400 px in the image. If it is a dinner plate of about 26 cm, that is roughly 15 px per cm.

The tuna salad mound is about 220 px wide, or roughly 14 cm, and about 230 px tall, or roughly 15 cm. It is irregular, so its footprint is about 130 cm². At a height of about 2.5 cm, the volume is about 250 cm³ at most. Allowing for the loose packing and the uneven shape, I estimate about 170 g.

The mix looks like tuna with mayonnaise, celery, red onion and a few shreds of carrot. I split it into tuna salad and a small amount of the visible add-ins.

The carrot on the side plate is a separate dish and not part of this meal, so I leave it out.
